summary_markdown: The session covered the migration of DScreens from staging to production, including a request for recalculation of molls. Later, discussion focused on updating and utilizing an analytics script. A specific parameter adjustment was discussed: changing the 'gap' parameter value from 8 to 15 minutes, which [me] confirmed would consume 0.25 units. It was also confirmed that the latest version of the script should be used for non-moll models.
decisions: DScreens were moved from staging to production.
The 'gap' parameter in the script was updated to 15 minutes.
The latest script version must be used for all non-moll models.
